items.author: kupo.blue
items.context: All that over leveling to not have to sit through the Yunalesca cutscene again… and guess when the Steam Deck crashes? Right at the end of it. So now I’m on a different Proton version and praying 😢 So sick of this ONE cutscene bc I associate it with game over screens 🤣
items.text: Crashing right at the end is the worst. If this Proton version doesn't hold, player reports for the game often say which version runs best on the Deck. Good luck!
